name: @fw/measure-chromium
description: Counts lane, Chromium arm: deterministic per-frame work counts from chromium-headless-shell with BeginFrameControl, in a Linux arm64 container.

scripts.determinism: node src/host.mjs --profile swipe-v1 --label det-a && node src/host.mjs --profile swipe-v1 --label det-b && node src/compare.mjs out/swipe-v1/det-a/counts.json out/swipe-v1/det-b/counts.json
